note: Terrell County TX publishes no zoning districts service. Texas counties cannot adopt zoning ordinances; the only community, Sanderson (county seat), is an unincorporated census-designated place with no city zoning. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web found no zoning district layer for the county or Sanderson; only third-party zoning maps (zoneomics) and parcel data without zoning values.
